tools.name: neon_get_organization_profile
tools.description: Fetch the Neon CRM organization these credentials belong to — its name, org ID and app URL. A cheap way to confirm the org ID and API key work. Neon: GET /properties/organizationProfile.

tools.name: neon_list_accounts
tools.description: List constituent accounts (individuals and companies), optionally filtered by email, first or last name, or type. Returns accountId, names, email and userType. For richer queries use neon_search. Neon: GET /accounts.

tools.name: neon_get_account
tools.description: Fetch one account in full — returned as individualAccount or companyAccount with its primary contact, addresses, consent, custom fields, current membership status and timestamps. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_search_fields
tools.description: Discover the field names neon_search accepts for a resource: kind=searchFields gives filterable fields with their allowed operators; kind=outputFields gives the columns you can return (standard field names plus custom fields with numeric ids). Call this before neon_search. Neon: GET /{resource}/sear

tools.name: neon_search
tools.description: Report-style search over accounts, donations (includes pledges and pledge payments), activities or events. Give filter criteria (field + operator + value), the output columns to return (standard field NAMES as strings, or custom-field IDS as integers — both from neon_list_search_fields), and 0-based

tools.name: neon_list_account_donations
tools.description: List one account's donations (amount, date, fund, campaign, purpose, status, payments), newest first by default. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/donations.

tools.name: neon_list_account_memberships
tools.description: List one account's membership history — level, term, start and end dates, fee, status (e.g. SUCCEEDED/FAILED) and auto-renewal. Filter to active or the primary active membership. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/memberships.

tools.name: neon_list_account_event_registrations
tools.description: List the event registrations one account has made, optionally for a single event. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/eventRegistrations.

tools.name: neon_get_donation
tools.description: Fetch one donation — amount, date, fund, campaign, purpose, source, tribute, soft-credit solicitor, payments and status. Neon: GET /donations/{id}.

tools.name: neon_get_membership
tools.description: Fetch one membership — level, term, dates, fee, status, auto-renewal, sub-members and payments. Neon: GET /memberships/{membershipId}.

tools.name: neon_list_membership_levels
tools.description: List the organization's membership levels (id, code, description, rank, type, status). Neon: GET /memberships/levels.

tools.name: neon_list_events
tools.description: List events, filterable by name, category, date window, published or archived state. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Only Neon's legacy events are exposed by the API. Neon: GET /events.

tools.name: neon_get_event
tools.description: Fetch one event — name, summary, dates, location, capacity, category, campaign, registration and financial settings. Neon: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_event_registrations
tools.description: List the registrations for one event — registrant account, tickets and attendees, amount, payments. Optionally only one registrant. Neon: GET /events/{id}/eventRegistrations.

tools.name: neon_list_campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns (id, code, name, status). Neon: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: neon_get_campaign
tools.description: Fetch one campaign — dates, goal, fund, purpose, parent campaign, status, page URLs and fundraising statistics. Neon: GET /campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: neon_get_activity
tools.description: Fetch one activity (a logged interaction or task) — subject, note, dates, linked accounts, assigned users, status and priority. Neon: GET /activities/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_properties
tools.description: List one of the organization's lookup lists — the ids other tools need: funds, purposes, sources, solicitation methods, activity statuses and system time zones (for neon_create_activity), system users, individual and company types, event categories, countries, states/provinces, genders, prefixes. tools.name: neon_create_account
tools.description: Create a constituent account: an INDIVIDUAL (a person) or a COMPANY (with company_name, plus an optional primary contact). Neon's Account Match may merge it into an existing account with the same name and email, so check neon_list_accounts by email first. Returns the new id. Neon: POST /accounts.

tools.name: neon_update_account
tools.description: Change an account's name, email, job title, company name or do-not-solicit / email opt-out flags. Only the fields you pass are changed (PATCH). The type must match the account (see neon_get_account). Addresses are not edited here. Neon: PATCH /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: neon_create_activity
tools.description: Create an activity — log an interaction with a constituent (call, meeting, note) or schedule a task. Needs a subject, a start date, a time zone id (neon_list_properties name=systemTimezones), a status id (name=activityStatuses) and a priority; link it to accounts and assign it to system users. tools.name: neon_update_activity
tools.description: Change an activity's subject, note, status (e.g. mark it completed) or priority. Only the fields you pass are changed (PATCH). Neon: PATCH /activities/{id}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "neon_get_organization_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: neon_get_organization_profile, neon_list_accounts, neon_search, neon_list_event_registrations, neon_get_campaign, neon_create_account · Private data: neon_get_organization_profile, neon_get_account, neon_create_account · Public sink: neon_list_accounts, neon_search, neon_create_account, neon_update_account, neon_create_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: neon_get_organization_profile, neon_list_accounts, neon_search, neon_list_event_registrations, neon_get_campaign, neon_create_account · Private data: neon_get_organization_profile, neon_get_account, neon_create_account · Public sink: neon_list_accounts, neon_search, neon_create_account, neon_update_account, neon_create_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
